verdict.rationale: The evidence shows TrueLayer verifying account ownership and storing bank details for its own payment initiation. Its WooCommerce, Shopify and Magento plugins make TrueLayer itself a payment method rather than passing verified account credentials to a third-party processor. No processor-token exchange or documented hand-off of linked-account credentials to external processors or platforms appears in the pack.

support.subject: As a developer, linked accounts plug into my payment processor — documented integrations or token exchange that hand verified account credentials to third-party processors and platforms
